name: Oosaki Akie
source:
A married woman who loves children and accepts foreign students.
The character is bright and caring, but there is also a tough side. 
She pretends she is not interested in sex,
she is unconsciously frustrated because she does not have much to do since she has a daughter.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=946937]Getchu[/url]]
